atoms.text: A heading is a title at the top of a page or book. There is even a heading on this page. It says “What is a Heading?”

instruction.text: Select the heading of the following text.

trainers.finishSound: The Dragonfly is the heading of this text.

atoms.b:
((The Dragonfly))
The Dragonfly is an insect.
It has two pairs of strong wings.
Dragonflies eat other smaller insects.

instruction.text: Select the heading of the following text.

atoms.b:
((A Ladybird))
A ladybird is a kind of beetle.
It is poisonous to many birds.
They have hidden wings under their shell.
